```{r}
library(inbolims)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(giscoR)
library(n2khab)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(scales)
```

# Purpose

This report delivers the graphs and descriptives for the VORA-pas report
of 09/2026.

# Data

```{r}
snapshot_dir <- here::here(
  "data", "snapshots", "vora-pas-2026-09-26"
)

le_fieldwork <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "le_fieldwork.rds"))
gw_fieldwork <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "gw_fieldwork.rds"))
gw_types <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "gw_types.rds"))
gw_domains <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "gw_domains.rds"))
surf_fieldwork <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "surf_fieldwork.rds"))
lims_sampleresults <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "lims_sampleresults.rds"))
rep_types <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "rep_types.rds"))
rep_sbz <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "rep_sbz.rds"))
vlaanderen_provincies <- readRDS(file.path(snapshot_dir, "vlaanderen_provincies.rds"))
```

# Transformations

```{r}
gw_locevals <- le_fieldwork |>
  filter(scheme == 'GW_03.3')

lims_ids <- lims_sampleresults |> 
  select(recipient_code) |>
  distinct() |> 
  add_column(in_lims = 1)

gw_samples <- gw_fieldwork |> 
  filter(is_sampled) |> 
  select(
    sampleunit_id
    , location_id
    , grts_address
    , sampling_date,
    , stratum
    , project_code
    , recipient_code
  )
```

# Analysis

## Loceval

**Total locevals**

```{r}
loceval_overview <- le_fieldwork |>
  summarise(
    total_locevals_over_schemes = n(),
    distinct_locevals = n_distinct(location_id, sampleunit_id),
    distinct_locations = n_distinct(grts_address)
  )

loceval_overview
```

**Locevals by scheme**

```{r}
loceval_by_scheme <- le_fieldwork |>
  group_by(scheme) |>
  summarise(
    nr_locevals = sum(loceval),
    distinct_locations = n_distinct(grts_address),
    nr_approved_locevals = sum(loceval_approved)
  )
loceval_by_scheme
```

**Locevals by category**

```{r}
loceval_by_category <- le_fieldwork |>
  group_by(issues, type_is_absent, is_replaced) |>
  summarise(
    nr_locevals = sum(loceval),
    nr_approved_locevals = sum(loceval_approved),
    distinct_locations = n_distinct(grts_address),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(issues), type_is_absent, is_replaced)
loceval_by_category
```

Interpretation:

- `issues = TRUE`: problematic visit; status undecided (in progress).
- `type_is_absent = FALSE`, `is_replaced = FALSE`: expected type
  present, no replacement –\> approved
- `type_is_absent = FALSE`, `is_replaced = TRUE`: expected type present
  with a local replacement –\> approved
- `type_is_absent = TRUE`, `is_replaced = FALSE`: expected type absent
  without possible replacement

\*\*Locevals with inconsistent data\*\* –\> in the report we use the
above interpretation

```{r}
loceval_inconsistent_data <- le_fieldwork |>
  filter(
    !issues,
    (
      (!type_is_absent & (is.na(type_assessed) | !coalesce(str_detect(type_assessed, fixed(type)) | str_detect(type, fixed(type_assessed)), FALSE))) |
        (type_is_absent & type == type_assessed)
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    scheme, grts_address, sampleunit_id, type, type_assessed, type_is_absent,
    is_replaced, date_visit, notes
  ) |>
  arrange(scheme, date_visit)
loceval_inconsistent_data
```

## Groundwater

**Total executed installations**

An executed installation is linked to a field calendar that

- is not excluded
- has a completed visit,
- and has no reported issue.

```{r}
gw_installation_summary <- gw_fieldwork |>
  summarise(
    # nr_installation_rows = n(),
    nr_sample_units = n_distinct(sampleunit_id),
    nr_locations = n_distinct(grts_address),
    nr_piezometers = n_distinct(watina_code_used_2_piezometer, na.rm = TRUE),
    nr_peilbuizen = n_distinct(watina_code_used_1_peilbuis, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
gw_installation_summary
```

**Installation counts by domain and typegroup**

The domain mapping groups fieldwork locations into the reporting areas.
Locations without a domain part are excluded from the grouped summary.

```{r}
gw_basetable <- gw_fieldwork |> 
  inner_join(
    gw_types,
    by = "stratum"
  ) |> 
  inner_join(
    rep_types,
    by = "type"
  ) |> 
  inner_join(
    gw_domains,
    by = "grts_address"
  ) |> 
  left_join(
    lims_ids,
    by = "recipient_code"
  ) |>
  replace_na(list(
    in_lims =  0
  ))
```

```{r}
gw_locevals_by_group <- gw_locevals |> 
  inner_join(
    rep_types,
    by = "type"
  ) |> 
  inner_join(
    gw_domains,
    by = "grts_address"
  ) |> 
  group_by(
    typegroup_name, domain_name
  ) |> 
  summarise(
    nr_locevals = sum(loceval),
    nr_approved_locevals = sum(loceval_approved)
  )

gw_installations_by_group <- gw_basetable |> 
  group_by(
    typegroup_name, domain_name
  ) |> 
  summarise(
    nr_instalations = n(),
    nr_visits = sum(nr_visits),
    nr_available_in_lims = sum(in_lims)
  )

gw_numbers <- gw_locevals_by_group |>
  left_join(
    gw_installations_by_group,
    by = c("typegroup_name", "domain_name")
  ) |> 
  arrange(typegroup_name, domain_name) |> 
  replace_na(list(
    nr_instalations = 0,
    nr_visits = 0,
    nr_available_in_lims = 0
  ))
```

```{r}
plot_gw_installations_samples <- ggplot() +
  # Laag 0: Omtrek en provinciegrenzen van Vlaanderen
  geom_sf(
    data = vlaanderen_provincies,
    fill = "white",
```

**Locevals by scheme**

```{r}
locevals_sf <- le_fieldwork |>
  filter(!is.na(wkb_geometry)) |>
  st_as_sf(wkt = "wkb_geometry", crs = 31370)

scheme_colors <- c(
  "GW_03.3"          = inbo_groen,
  "SOIL_03.2"        = inbo_roze,
  "SURF_03.4_lentic" = inbo_blauw
)

scheme_shapes <- c(
  "GW_03.3"          = 15,  # square
  "SOIL_03.2"        = 17,  # triangle
  "SURF_03.4_lentic" = 16   # circle
)

# Rarest scheme last -> plotted on top, so it isn't hidden by the others
scheme_order <- le_fieldwork |>
  count(scheme) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  pull(scheme)

locevals_sf <- locevals_sf |>
  mutate(scheme = factor(scheme, levels = scheme_order)) |>
  arrange(scheme)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 8

plot_locevals_by_scheme <- ggplot() +
  # Laag 0: Omtrek en provinciegrenzen van Vlaanderen
  geom_sf(
    data = vlaanderen_provincies,
    fill = "white",
    color = "grey55",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  # Laag 1: SBZ-H gebieden
  geom_sf(
    data = rep_sbz,
    fill = "grey75",
    color = "grey75",
    alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  # Laag 2: Locevals, per scheme (rarest on top)
  geom_sf(
    data = locevals_sf,
    aes(color = scheme, shape = scheme,  size = scheme)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scheme_colors, name = "Scheme") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = scheme_shapes, name = "Scheme") +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(3, 2, 1.5), name = "Scheme") +
  
  # Stijl en opmaak
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.spacing    = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    plot.margin      = margin(8, 8, 8, 8),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  )
```

## Chemical variables

Analysis of combined groundwater data (from veldwerkdatabank) and LIMS
data.

```{r}
data_chemical_variables <- gw_samples |> 
  inner_join(
    lims_sampleresults,
    by = c("recipient_code")
  ) |> arrange(
    in_lims,
    recipient_code
  )
```

Are there samples with negative values (should be zero)?

```{r}
data_chemical_variables |> 
  filter(value <= 0)
```

```{r}
base_chem <- data_chemical_variables |> 
  inner_join(
    gw_types,
    by = "stratum"
  ) |> 
  inner_join(
    rep_types,
    by = "type"
  ) |> 
  inner_join(
    gw_domains,
    by = "grts_address"
  )

base_chem <- base_chem |> 
  group_by(
    typegroup_name, domain_name, grts_address, stratum, chem_variable, unit
  ) |> 
  summarise(
    value = mean(value),
    nr_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    domain_name = factor(
      domain_name,
      levels = c(
        "Kalmthoutse Heide",
        "Turnhouts Vennengebied",
        "Mechelse Heide",
        "Voerstreek",
        "De Maten",
        "Overig SBZ-H",
        "Overig Vlaanderen"
      )
    )
  )

base_chem_filtered <- base_chem |> 
  group_by(typegroup_name, domain_name, chem_variable) |> 
  filter(n() >= 2) |> 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
base_chem |> 
  group_by(domain_name) |> 
  summarize(
    nr_obs = n_distinct(grts_address)
  )
```

```{r}
domain_colors <- c(
  "Kalmthoutse Heide"      = "#0072B2",
  "Turnhouts Vennengebied"  = "#56B4E9",
  "Mechelse Heide"         = "#CC79A7",
  "Voerstreek"             = "#009E73",
  "De Maten"               = "#E69F00",
  "Overig SBZ-H"           = "#F0E442",
  "Overig Vlaanderen"      = "#999999"
)

domain_labels <- c(
  "Kalmthoutse Heide" = "Kalmthoutse\nHeide",
  "Turnhouts Vennengebied" = "Turnhouts\nVennengebied",
  "Mechelse Heide" = "Mechelse\nHeide",
  "Voerstreek" = "Voerstreek",
  "De Maten" = "De Maten",
  "Overig SBZ-H" = "Overig\nSBZ-H",
  "Overig Vlaanderen" = "Overig\nVlaanderen"
)

chem_variable_labels <- c(
  "N-NH4" = "Ammonium (N-NH4)",
  "N-NO3" = "Nitraat (N-NO3)",
  "P-PO4" = "Fosfaat (P-PO4)",
  "SO4" = "Sulfaat (SO4)"
)

theme_chem <- function() {
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

get_legend_labels <- function(data) {
  counts <- data |> 
    group_by(domain_name) |> 
    summarize(
      nr_obs = n_distinct(grts_address)
    )
  
  # Format as "Domain Name (n = XX)"
  labels <- paste0(counts$domain_name, " (n = ", counts$nr_obs, ")")
  names(labels) <- counts$domain_name
  return(labels)
}

add_observation_counts <- function(plot_data, by_typegroup = FALSE) {
  if (by_typegroup) {
    plot_data |>
      count(typegroup_name, chem_variable, domain_name, name = "nr_observations")
  } else {
    plot_data |>
      count(chem_variable, domain_name, name = "nr_observations")
  }
}

plot_chem_var <- function(data, selected_variables = NULL) {
  plot_data <- data
  if (!is.null(selected_variables)) {
    plot_data <- data |> 
      filter(chem_variable %in% selected_variables)
  }
  
  ggplot(
    plot_data, 
    aes(x = domain_name, y = value, fill = domain_name)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = label_number()) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = domain_colors,
      labels = get_legend_labels(plot_data),
      name = "Domein"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ chem_variable,
      scales = "free_y",
      labeller = labeller(chem_variable = chem_variable_labels)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Chemische variabelen per domein",
      x = NULL,
      y = "concentratie (mg/l)"
    ) +
    theme_chem()
}
```

**Overall distribution**

```{r}
plot_chem_overall <- plot_chem_var(base_chem)
plot_chem_overall
```

```{r}
plot_chem_selected <- plot_chem_var(base_chem, c("N-NH4", "N-NO3"))
plot_chem_selected
```

**Distribution by typegroup**

```{r}
plot_list <- base_chem_filtered %>%
  group_by(typegroup_name, .drop = TRUE) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  set_names(map_chr(., ~ as.character(unique(.x$typegroup_name)))) %>%
  map(~ {
    current_typegroup <- unique(.x$typegroup_name)
    
    plot_chem_var(.x) +
      labs(subtitle = current_typegroup)
  })
```

```{r}
walk(plot_list, print)
```

```{r}
plot_list_selected_var <- base_chem_filtered %>%
  group_by(typegroup_name, .drop = TRUE) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  set_names(map_chr(., ~ as.character(unique(.x$typegroup_name)))) %>%
  map(~ {
    current_typegroup <- unique(.x$typegroup_name)
    
    plot_chem_var(.x, c("N-NH4", "N-NO3")) +
      labs(subtitle = current_typegroup)
  })
```

```{r}
walk(plot_list_selected_var, print)
```
